general.title: General
general.subtitle: Command prefix and language.
general.prefixHint: Used alongside slash commands, e.g. {prefix}ping. Leave blank to use the default.

leave.title: Leave
leave.subtitle: Sent when a member leaves the server.
leave.messageHint: Supports the same placeholders as the welcome message: {p1}, {p2}, {p3}.

welcome.title: Welcome & Autoroles
welcome.subtitle: Welcome message and automatic role assignment for new members.
welcome.messageHint: Supports placeholders like {p1}, {p2}, {p3}, {p4}, and embed builders like {p5}.
welcome.autorolesSubtitle: Up to 2 roles per type, assigned automatically when a member joins.
welcome.noRoles: No assignable roles found in this server.

starboard.title: Starboard
starboard.subtitle: Pins community-highlighted messages once they collect enough star reactions.
starboard.emojiHint: Choose a standard emoji or a custom server emoji (non-animated, available to everyone).
starboard.thresholdHint: Minimum number of stars a message needs to reach the starboard.
starboard.selfStarsLabel: Allow authors to star their own messages

embeds.title: Embeds
embeds.subtitle: Build, preview, and send embeds to any channel in the server.
embeds.cooldownActive: Cooldown active: you can send another embed in {seconds}s.
embeds.sentPartial: Sent, but {count} reaction(s) could not be added.
embeds.invalidUrl: Invalid URL (must start with http:// or https://).
embeds.emptyEmbedError: Add content or at least one embed with data.

validation.notObject: The JSON is not a valid object.
validation.missingEmbeds: Must include at least one embed in 'embeds'.
validation.invalidColor: {label}: color must be an integer between 0 and 16777215.
validation.totalCharactersExceeded: Combined text total ({total}) exceeds Discord's {max}-character limit.
validation.invalidTitleUrl: {label}: title URL is not valid (must start with http:// or https://).
validation.invalidAuthorIconUrl: {label}: author icon URL is not valid.
validation.invalidFooterIconUrl: {label}: footer icon URL is not valid.
validation.parseError: The file does not contain valid JSON (syntax error).

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.subtitle: Private support threads for members, opened via a button panel.
tickets.channelHint: Hosts the "Open Ticket" button and is where new private ticket threads are created. The bot needs View Channel, Send Messages, Embed Links, Create Private Threads, and Send Messages in Threads here.
tickets.staffRoleHint: Automatically added to new tickets and mentioned when one opens.
tickets.welcomeMessageHint: Posted inside every new ticket. Supports placeholders like {p1}, {p2}.
